verdicts.reason: A and B are pixel-identical, so this is a tie. Both have the same flaws. The can has shrunk to a small sticker inside the green circle, so the product is no longer the hero. The SOLSTICE wordmark floats at the left with no shared edge with the can or the headline. The two-line body copy is tiny (about 8px), cut across by the peach circle, and wedged between the bottom edge and a CTA that is too small. The headline does read well.
